title: Improving the Interparticle Bonding and Ductility of Cold Sprayed Aluminum Alloys by Deformation Processing

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: Gen III High-Pressure Portable Cold Spray System

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: a small fraction of the particles had distinctly weaker bonding, i.e., less metallurgical bonding, than the rest. strain-hardened microstructure.  unbonded particle boundaries also have layers of densely populated oxide particle

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: Gen III High-Pressure Portable Cold Spray System
experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: standard T6 heat treatments: solutionizing at 495°C for 1h and water quench to room temperature, followed by artificial aging at 195°C for 12h

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: a small fraction of the particles had distinctly weaker bonding, i.e., less metallurgical bonding, than the rest

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: Gen III High-Pressure Portable Cold Spray System

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: increased interparticle bonding compared to N2 sprayed Al6061, but not completely metallurgically bonded. severely strained microstructure. cellular grains in particles, about 1 μm in diameter. shows an opening at a triple particle junction, meaning full density not achieved. oxide layers along particle boundaries are highly continuous

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: Gen III High-Pressure Portable Cold Spray System
